verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk and centred in the banner: wide empty pink bands on both sides, and the body copy, brand name and bubble text are tiny and hard to read. The structure is intact, though: headline, URL and the three bubbles with their avatars all hold together. B pulls the design apart: avatars and emoji are detached from their bubbles, the 'I will still order' bubble is empty, the logo floats on a stray teal blob, pink bars and a quarter circle are scattered at random, the brand name is microscopic and the URL is pushed to the top-right corner, so the result is unusable.
